package faux // import "github.com/mrsibe/goat/ai/faux"

Package faux provides a deterministic scripted model for tests.

Stability: this package is test-only and is not covered by the v1.0 public API
compatibility promise.

TYPES

type Model struct {
	ModelInfo ai.ModelInfo
	Turns     []Turn
	Requests  []ai.Request
}
    Model returns pre-scripted turns and records requests.

func New(turns ...Turn) *Model
    New creates a scripted model.

func (m *Model) Info() ai.ModelInfo
    Info implements ai.Model.

func (m *Model) Stream(_ context.Context, request ai.Request) (ai.Stream, error)
    Stream implements ai.Model.

type Turn struct {
	Events    []ai.Event
	StartErr  error
	StreamErr error
}
    Turn is one scripted model response.
